fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting critical of Gov. Fuller Warren and Florida’s new sales tax, including discussion of how the tax is collected and its effects on merchants and consumers. Reports on a deep test oil well being drilled near Crossman Hammock southwest of Coral Gables and anticipates potential oil production in Dade County. Covers a death following detention and transfer to the Miami Retreat involving Miami Beach police and an ordered autopsy, and includes commentary on Miami Beach civic and political disputes, including Miami Junior Chamber of Commerce election activity. Additional items address gambling on Lincoln Road, traffic-safety guidance for children, growth in frozen concentrated orange juice production, and a column on U.S. war preparations and West Germany’s role as an ally.
